raw: You have determined that the momentous migration has come to a conclusion in reality.
content: You have determined that the momentous migration has come to a conclusion in reality.

raw: That conclusion has been mapped onto the space you are in. The rift that looks as if it has been plowed open by a Catastrophe bisects the plaza in front of the Basilica. By the rift, there is an even more eye-grabbing pit.
content: That conclusion has been mapped onto the space you are in. The rift that looks as if it has been plowed open by a Catastrophe bisects the plaza in front of the Basilica. By the rift, there is an even more eye-grabbing pit.

raw: Ugly scars in what should have been a city trapped in stasis.
content: Ugly scars in what should have been a city trapped in stasis.

raw: The ring-shaped machine sits silently within.
content: The ring-shaped machine sits silently within.

options: Did the PCS system... crash?

raw: You look at Priestess. She remains calm, as if she does not care about what has happened in the slightest.
content: You look at Priestess. She remains calm, as if she does not care about what has happened in the slightest.
You feel uneasy.

raw: [name="Mon3tr"]Analysis complete! Ten standard seconds ago, at least two massive explosions took place in the Basilica plaza.
speaker: Mon3tr
content: Analysis complete! Ten standard seconds ago, at least two massive explosions took place in the Basilica plaza.

raw: [name="Mon3tr"]I'm certain the instigators were Exusiai, Executor, and a silver-haired Sankta. The constant flickering of the freeze-frames by the explosion point are proof enough.
speaker: Mon3tr
content: I'm certain the instigators were Exusiai, Executor, and a silver-haired Sankta. The constant flickering of the freeze-frames by the explosion point are proof enough.

raw: [Decision(options="The programmatic bombs we helped Exusiai make worked.;The machine's structure shouldn't have been that weak.", values="1;2")]
options: The programmatic bombs we helped Exusiai make worked.;The machine's structure shouldn't have been that weak.

raw: [name="Mon3tr"]We can't pat ourselves on the back just yet, Doctor!
speaker: Mon3tr
content: We can't pat ourselves on the back just yet, Doctor!

raw: [name="Mon3tr"](Priestess still hasn't made her next move.)
speaker: Mon3tr
content: (Priestess still hasn't made her next move.)

raw: [name="Mon3tr"](We need a way to stop her from changing the situation, no matter what.)
speaker: Mon3tr
content: (We need a way to stop her from changing the situation, no matter what.)

raw: [name="Mon3tr"]You're right. Its structure would definitely have been able to withstand any attacks the angels can execute. It was designed to operate in even harsher environments, after all.
speaker: Mon3tr
content: You're right. Its structure would definitely have been able to withstand any attacks the angels can execute. It was designed to operate in even harsher environments, after all.

raw: [name="Mon3tr"](Priestess should be able to reactivate it. We need to stop her from doing that.)
speaker: Mon3tr
content: (Priestess should be able to reactivate it. We need to stop her from doing that.)

speaker: Mon3tr
content: *sigh* Sorry, Doctor.

raw: [name="Mon3tr"]I should've come alone to carry out this mission. I never should've let you take on this risk—
speaker: Mon3tr
content: I should've come alone to carry out this mission. I never should've let you take on this risk—

raw: [Decision(options="You're used to standing in front of me by now, Mon3tr.", values="1")]
options: You're used to standing in front of me by now, Mon3tr.
(Smile);Thanks.

speaker: Mon3tr
content: Huh?

raw: [Decision(options="Things might not be as bad as you think.", values="1")]
options: Things might not be as bad as you think.

raw: [Decision(options="I can verify Priestess's condition now.", values="1")]
options: I can verify Priestess's condition now.

speaker: Mon3tr
content: Her... condition?

raw: You walk past Mon3tr toward Priestess. Mon3tr immediately tenses up, and she pulls on your arm.
content: You walk past Mon3tr toward Priestess. Mon3tr immediately tenses up, and she pulls on your arm.

speaker: Mon3tr
content: Doctor!

options: Don't worry.;Trust me.

raw: After a brief moment of hesitation, she lets go, but decides to stick close to you as you walk ahead.
content: After a brief moment of hesitation, she lets go, but decides to stick close to you as you walk ahead.
You stand shoulder-to-shoulder with Priestess.

raw: [Decision(options="This city's scars are rather inharmonious.;You've allowed these redundant parameters to mix with your data.", values="1;2")]
options: This city's scars are rather inharmonious.;You've allowed these redundant parameters to mix with your data.

raw: [name="Priestess"]These unremarkable strings ultimately caused the entire program to crash, {@nickname}. There is no guaranteeing a language will operate in eternal perfection.
speaker: Priestess
content: These unremarkable strings ultimately caused the entire program to crash, {@nickname}. There is no guaranteeing a language will operate in eternal perfection.

raw: [name="Priestess"]I know what you want to say. Even Originium, the language we created together, has limitations.
speaker: Priestess
content: I know what you want to say. Even Originium, the language we created together, has limitations.

raw: [name="Priestess"]It needs more time to adjust and iterate.
speaker: Priestess
content: It needs more time to adjust and iterate.

raw: [name="Priestess"]Sometimes I cannot help but wonder if what is truly stopping Originium from reaching perfection is not a design flaw... but us.
speaker: Priestess
content: Sometimes I cannot help but wonder if what is truly stopping Originium from reaching perfection is not a design flaw... but us.

raw: [name="Priestess"]Human emotion and reason are both able to fetter the development of a language.
speaker: Priestess
content: Human emotion and reason are both able to fetter the development of a language.

raw: [name="Priestess"]We debated this several times during the creation process, but there was never a clear winner.
speaker: Priestess
content: We debated this several times during the creation process, but there was never a clear winner.

raw: [name="Priestess"]Luckily, we both accepted that this uncertainty exists within Originium.
speaker: Priestess
content: Luckily, we both accepted that this uncertainty exists within Originium.

options: ...I don't understand your meaning.

raw: [name="Priestess"]Has memory loss affected your ability for divergent thinking?
speaker: Priestess
content: Has memory loss affected your ability for divergent thinking?

raw: [name="Priestess"]I'm glad to see you so perplexed, though. It is a marked difference from how I used to communicate with {@nickname}.
speaker: Priestess
content: I'm glad to see you so perplexed, though. It is a marked difference from how I used to communicate with {@nickname}.

raw: [name="Priestess"]'Perfection' implies a strict upper bound. 'Flaw', on the other hand, means we still have the chance for a breakthrough. This was {@nickname}'s stance on the matter.
speaker: Priestess
content: 'Perfection' implies a strict upper bound. 'Flaw', on the other hand, means we still have the chance for a breakthrough. This was {@nickname}'s stance on the matter.

raw: [name="Priestess"]When the crisis we must resolve is still inexplicable, chasing perfection will only lead us to our graves.
speaker: Priestess
content: When the crisis we must resolve is still inexplicable, chasing perfection will only lead us to our graves.

raw: [Decision(options="No, this has nothing to do with the current circumstances.", values="1")]
options: No, this has nothing to do with the current circumstances.

raw: [Decision(options="You... can't change this situation.;This is different from our first encounter on the deck.", values="1;2")]
options: You... can't change this situation.;This is different from our first encounter on the deck.

speaker: Priestess
content: When did you figure it out?

options: Just now.

raw: [Decision(options="...You could have stopped the programmatic bombs from detonating.;...You could have used Originium to close the rift.;...You could have left the saints trapped in the maze.", values="1;2;3")]
options: ...You could have stopped the programmatic bombs from detonating.;...You could have used Originium to close the rift.;...You could have left the saints trapped in the maze.

raw: [Decision(options="It would have been easy for you to do that.;It's like when you awakened and ruined Rhodes Island.", values="1;2")]
options: It would have been easy for you to do that.;It's like when you awakened and ruined Rhodes Island.

raw: [Decision(options="You didn't eliminate Mon3tr and me from the get-go.", values="1")]
options: You didn't eliminate Mon3tr and me from the get-go.

raw: [Decision(options="You've got problems of your own.", values="1")]
options: You've got problems of your own.

speaker: Priestess
content: That much is obvious, {@nickname}.

raw: [name="Priestess"]But only now have you mustered up the courage to stand by me.
speaker: Priestess
content: But only now have you mustered up the courage to stand by me.

raw: [name="Priestess"]I had hoped the one standing by my side could have peacefully shared in the solitude that took root deep in our thoughts, during our long hibernations.
speaker: Priestess
content: I had hoped the one standing by my side could have peacefully shared in the solitude that took root deep in our thoughts, during our long hibernations.

raw: [name="Priestess"]It's a shame you can't do that.
speaker: Priestess
content: It's a shame you can't do that.

raw: [name="Priestess"]We are not as we were in the past. Far too much has happened since, has it not?
speaker: Priestess
content: We are not as we were in the past. Far too much has happened since, has it not?

raw: [Decision(options="You really haven't hid anything from me.;You're more like a... riddle.", values="1;2")]
options: You really haven't hid anything from me.;You're more like a... riddle.

speaker: Priestess
content: Still curious about me?

raw: [name="Priestess"]This 'Mon3tr' no longer has any limitations on her. She can clear up some of your confusion.
speaker: Priestess
content: This 'Mon3tr' no longer has any limitations on her. She can clear up some of your confusion.

raw: [name="Priestess"]You fear {@nickname} will learn the truth, AMa-10?
speaker: Priestess
content: You fear {@nickname} will learn the truth, AMa-10?

raw: [name="Priestess"]To be honest, I would much rather {@nickname} come to me in person, like earlier.
speaker: Priestess
content: To be honest, I would much rather {@nickname} come to me in person, like earlier.

raw: [name="Priestess"]My days in the sarcophagus were excruciating. It was as if my thoughts were floating through a fetid morass, wherein I lost all sense of the flow of time.
speaker: Priestess
content: My days in the sarcophagus were excruciating. It was as if my thoughts were floating through a fetid morass, wherein I lost all sense of the flow of time.

raw: [name="Priestess"]My only consolation was the never-ending loop of debates seared into our minds, though not to reassure me of our shared vision.
speaker: Priestess
content: My only consolation was the never-ending loop of debates seared into our minds, though not to reassure me of our shared vision.

raw: [name="Priestess"]I have never once doubted my path.
speaker: Priestess
content: I have never once doubted my path.

raw: [name="Priestess"]Through 'debate', I got my only chance to communicate with a certain someone again—
speaker: Priestess
content: Through 'debate', I got my only chance to communicate with a certain someone again—

raw: [name="Priestess"]I'm not demanding you understand everything on my mind right away. Before the final day comes, you can continue to walk the path you believe in.
speaker: Priestess
content: I'm not demanding you understand everything on my mind right away. Before the final day comes, you can continue to walk the path you believe in.

raw: [name="Priestess"]Our disagreements are destined to continue, even if you no longer remember that one's reasons for disagreeing with me.
speaker: Priestess
content: Our disagreements are destined to continue, even if you no longer remember that one's reasons for disagreeing with me.

raw: [name="Priestess"]I look forward to seeing how your beloved Terra can prove to me that your struggle still has some value... the way the people of Laterano just did.
speaker: Priestess
content: I look forward to seeing how your beloved Terra can prove to me that your struggle still has some value... the way the people of Laterano just did.

raw: [name="Priestess"]But there is something else I am equally certain of. Oracle will return.
speaker: Priestess
content: But there is something else I am equally certain of. Oracle will return.

speaker: Priestess
content: So, {@nickname}, I will wait for you.

raw: As she looks out at the city devoid of life, she sighs.
content: As she looks out at the city devoid of life, she sighs.

raw: [name="Priestess"]At times, I think they are far too like us. If you had enough time, perhaps...
speaker: Priestess
content: At times, I think they are far too like us. If you had enough time, perhaps...
She begins to fade away.

raw: [name="Priestess"]Ah, yes, I can indeed restore AMa-10.
speaker: Priestess
content: Ah, yes, I can indeed restore AMa-10.

raw: [name="Priestess"]If you are determined to see it done, make a wish to Originium, {@nickname}.
speaker: Priestess
content: If you are determined to see it done, make a wish to Originium, {@nickname}.

speaker: Priestess
content: I will hear your voice.

raw: Priestess vanishes without a trace—your target is gone.
content: Priestess vanishes without a trace—your target is gone.

raw: There is only silence, absolute silence. You and Mon3tr are the only ones left trapped inside this colorless ghost town.
content: There is only silence, absolute silence. You and Mon3tr are the only ones left trapped inside this colorless ghost town.

options: She's gone...

speaker: Mon3tr
content: Umm... I guess that's it, then?

options: Perhaps.

raw: [Decision(options="The Sanktas resolved their crisis by themselves.", values="1")]
options: The Sanktas resolved their crisis by themselves.

raw: [Decision(options="I've also confirmed Priestess's current condition.", values="1")]
options: I've also confirmed Priestess's current condition.

raw: [Decision(options="Her loss of control over Originium is more serious than we thought.", values="1")]
options: Her loss of control over Originium is more serious than we thought.

speaker: Mon3tr
content: That's really important information, Doctor!

raw: [name="Mon3tr"]While we can't be sure how long she'll need to get back to normal, at the very least, we have a chance to stop her.
speaker: Mon3tr
content: While we can't be sure how long she'll need to get back to normal, at the very least, we have a chance to stop her.

speaker: Mon3tr
content: Oh, right, she mentioned... Kal'tsit... earlier...

raw: [Decision(options="I don't trust her, Mon3tr.;We shouldn't wish upon Originium, even if it's for Kal'tsit.", values="1;2")]
options: I don't trust her, Mon3tr.;We shouldn't wish upon Originium, even if it's for Kal'tsit.

raw: [name="Mon3tr"]I know. I don't approve of using her methods to bring back Kal'tsit either.
speaker: Mon3tr
content: I know. I don't approve of using her methods to bring back Kal'tsit either.

raw: [name="Mon3tr"]She inflicted grievous wounds on Rhodes Island and Laterano. Every time she appears, she drops something mind-blowing on us, and then points toward some even more unknowable crisis... I don't understand her at all.
speaker: Mon3tr
content: She inflicted grievous wounds on Rhodes Island and Laterano. Every time she appears, she drops something mind-blowing on us, and then points toward some even more unknowable crisis... I don't understand her at all.

raw: [Decision(options="We've been researching a long time now.", values="1")]
options: We've been researching a long time now.
We have our own methods.

raw: [name="Mon3tr"]We're going to be setting out on a really long road, aren't we?
speaker: Mon3tr
content: We're going to be setting out on a really long road, aren't we?

raw: You finally notice what's odd about Mon3tr. Your enemy has retreated, the crisis has passed, but the young woman, normally so lively and energetic, does not smile like she usually does.
content: You finally notice what's odd about Mon3tr. Your enemy has retreated, the crisis has passed, but the young woman, normally so lively and energetic, does not smile like she usually does.
She even looks somewhat solemn.

raw: Mon3tr hasn't been reconstructed for very long. You still haven't gotten completely used to her new appearance, nor has she had the time to adapt to the changes in her body, or the loss that cut her to the bone.
content: Mon3tr hasn't been reconstructed for very long. You still haven't gotten completely used to her new appearance, nor has she had the time to adapt to the changes in her body, or the loss that cut her to the bone.

raw: But she has been thrown into mission after mission far too quickly. Rebuilding Rhodes Island, saving Laterano... Perhaps it has taken up until now for her to finally have the chance to speak her mind.
content: But she has been thrown into mission after mission far too quickly. Rebuilding Rhodes Island, saving Laterano... Perhaps it has taken up until now for her to finally have the chance to speak her mind.

raw: [Decision(options="No need to be so pessimistic, Mon3tr—;Don't give up, Mon3tr—", values="1;2")]
options: No need to be so pessimistic, Mon3tr—;Don't give up, Mon3tr—

speaker: Mon3tr
content: I'll bring back Kal'tsit!

raw: [name="Mon3tr"]I'll also protect Amiya, and you too!
speaker: Mon3tr
content: I'll also protect Amiya, and you too!

raw: Mon3tr looks up at you all of a sudden, interrupting your train of thought.
content: Mon3tr looks up at you all of a sudden, interrupting your train of thought.

raw: [name="Mon3tr"]I haven't forgotten what Kal'tsit told me!
speaker: Mon3tr
content: I haven't forgotten what Kal'tsit told me!

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]If the outcome I fear most does come to pass, if the one I least want to see stands in front of us once more—
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: If the outcome I fear most does come to pass, if the one I least want to see stands in front of us once more—

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Protect the Doctor. Protect Amiya.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]I will engrave this directive into your basic behavioral strategy matrix.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: I will engrave this directive into your basic behavioral strategy matrix.

raw: Eternal life is destined to be eternally lonely. I have tasted it.
content: Eternal life is destined to be eternally lonely. I have tasted it.
...You can walk alone—
Mon3tr.

options: Listen to me, Mon3tr.

raw: You look at her, and slowly, you begin to speak.
content: You look at her, and slowly, you begin to speak.

raw: [Decision(options="You haven't been in your reconstructed body for very long.", values="1")]
options: You haven't been in your reconstructed body for very long.

raw: [Decision(options="Don't put too much pressure on yourself.;Kal'tsit wouldn't want her hopes to turn into chains.", values="1;2")]
options: Don't put too much pressure on yourself.;Kal'tsit wouldn't want her hopes to turn into chains.

raw: [name="Mon3tr"]Err... I think you're misunderstanding something, Doctor.
speaker: Mon3tr
content: Err... I think you're misunderstanding something, Doctor.

raw: [name="Mon3tr"]I'll always remember how, when I awoke, you just turned around and walked away after giving me a 'welcome back'...
speaker: Mon3tr
content: I'll always remember how, when I awoke, you just turned around and walked away after giving me a 'welcome back'...

options: Oh...;Sorry, Mon3tr.

raw: [name="Mon3tr"]It's fine, it's fine. I needed time to get used to not being in a symbiotic relationship after thousands of years, and you needed time to accept the loss of someone you've fought beside for such a long time. And now...
speaker: Mon3tr
content: It's fine, it's fine. I needed time to get used to not being in a symbiotic relationship after thousands of years, and you needed time to accept the loss of someone you've fought beside for such a long time. And now...

raw: [name="Mon3tr"]We're both standing here, right in front of one another.
speaker: Mon3tr
content: We're both standing here, right in front of one another.

raw: [name="Mon3tr"]But we've already known each other for quite a while, haven't we, Doctor?
speaker: Mon3tr
content: But we've already known each other for quite a while, haven't we, Doctor?

raw: [name="Mon3tr"]Under the cannon fire of Londinium, deep inside the secret caverns of the Sarkaz, below the tail of that giant ring flying into the sky in Trimounts, in Milliarium's Sophontheatrum...
speaker: Mon3tr
content: Under the cannon fire of Londinium, deep inside the secret caverns of the Sarkaz, below the tail of that giant ring flying into the sky in Trimounts, in Milliarium's Sophontheatrum...

raw: [name="Mon3tr"]Kal'tsit was there for all of those, which means I was too.
speaker: Mon3tr
content: Kal'tsit was there for all of those, which means I was too.

raw: [name="Mon3tr"]It's not like I only started to follow her orders to understand you and Rhodes Island when she left us.
speaker: Mon3tr
content: It's not like I only started to follow her orders to understand you and Rhodes Island when she left us.

raw: [name="Mon3tr"]Becoming a Rhodes Island Operator, putting up a fight against our creator, protecting Amiya, protecting you. These were my decisions as well...
speaker: Mon3tr
content: Becoming a Rhodes Island Operator, putting up a fight against our creator, protecting Amiya, protecting you. These were my decisions as well...

raw: [name="Mon3tr"]And what I've been doing all along.
speaker: Mon3tr
content: And what I've been doing all along.
Silence.

raw: You look at Mon3tr. Silence links the two of you.
content: You look at Mon3tr. Silence links the two of you.

options: Then count me in, Mon3tr.

raw: [Decision(options="We'll bring Kal'tsit back.;We'll walk to the end of this uncharted road.", values="1;2")]
options: We'll bring Kal'tsit back.;We'll walk to the end of this uncharted road.

raw: Eternal life is destined to be eternally lonely, but thankfully, we do not walk alone on the journeys we take. Even if all life is sapped of color, even if all things fade away into nothingness...
content: Eternal life is destined to be eternally lonely, but thankfully, we do not walk alone on the journeys we take. Even if all life is sapped of color, even if all things fade away into nothingness...

raw: We can, must, walk onwards together.
content: We can, must, walk onwards together.

raw: This is what she hoped for.
content: This is what she hoped for.

speaker: Mon3tr
content: Oh...

raw: [Decision(options="What's wrong?;Got another question to ponder?", values="1;2")]
options: What's wrong?;Got another question to ponder?

speaker: Mon3tr
content: What's with the look?

raw: [name="Mon3tr"]The counseling session is over, commander! No problems here, I had just come up with a way to get out of this blasted place, and I'll need your help!
speaker: Mon3tr
content: The counseling session is over, commander! No problems here, I had just come up with a way to get out of this blasted place, and I'll need your help!

raw: [name="Mon3tr"]According to Priestess, this should be a space created by that machine after it connected to Originium, some kind of model based on the future.
speaker: Mon3tr
content: According to Priestess, this should be a space created by that machine after it connected to Originium, some kind of model based on the future.

raw: [Decision(options="So there's a relation to Originium's properties here.", values="1")]
options: So there's a relation to Originium's properties here.

raw: [Decision(options="We can try cracking those abnormal nodes.", values="1")]
options: We can try cracking those abnormal nodes.

raw: [name="Mon3tr"]Abnormal nodes? Ah, you mean the parts with damage mapped onto them.
speaker: Mon3tr
content: Abnormal nodes? Ah, you mean the parts with damage mapped onto them.

raw: [Decision(options="The restriction on the connection between you and the machine should be gone, right?", values="1")]
options: The restriction on the connection between you and the machine should be gone, right?

raw: [name="Mon3tr"]Yep, I can sense its signal, though its getting weaker by the second.
speaker: Mon3tr
content: Yep, I can sense its signal, though its getting weaker by the second.

speaker: Mon3tr
content: I'll try reestablishing the connection...
name: Mon3tr

speaker: Mon3tr
content: But what then?
name: Mon3tr

raw: [Decision(options="Keep requesting refactoring of the abnormal nodes.;Use up the last of its computing power.", values="1;2")]
options: Keep requesting refactoring of the abnormal nodes.;Use up the last of its computing power.

raw: [name="Mon3tr"]Shouldn't be too difficult for me when Priestess isn't meddling with things.
speaker: Mon3tr
content: Shouldn't be too difficult for me when Priestess isn't meddling with things.

content: It starts from the street to the right of the Tower of Revelations, and then through the Notarial Hall and firearms workshops in Pagus Michaelion, to the Sunset Chapel in Pagus Saint Marcel, and then all the way to the chapel square...

raw: Noise returns to the Holy City.
content: Noise returns to the Holy City.

raw: It is the sound of Laterans offering a prayer to life.
content: It is the sound of Laterans offering a prayer to life.

speaker: Mon3tr
content: The color's back?!

options: Let's go, Mon3tr.

raw: [name="Mon3tr"]Not going to go say hi to Exusiai?
speaker: Mon3tr
content: Not going to go say hi to Exusiai?

raw: [Decision(options="No need to hold her up before her reunion with family and friends.;We need to update the ship on what happened here in Laterano.", values="1;2")]
options: No need to hold her up before her reunion with family and friends.;We need to update the ship on what happened here in Laterano.

options: Priestess's disappearance will only be temporary.;Priestess will make her next move soon.;Our mission isn't over yet.
